name: Bounded delivery

## Result
What single observable result will this task deliver?

## Capability parent and dependencies
- Parent issue:
- Blocked by (also add GitHub native dependency links):
- Prerequisites already integrated:

## Planned files and interfaces
List intended new/modified files, existing consumers and overlap with open PRs.
Shared-interface changes require an agreed contract and integration order.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Exact positive/negative/limit cases are specified.
- [ ] Relevant contracts are preserved; unknown/unavailable evidence remains visible.
- [ ] Implementation demonstrates behavioral RED/GREEN and fresh root tests/vet.
- [ ] Documentation-only tasks record artifact review rather than claim Go execution.
- [ ] Record toolchain, executed evidence and remaining qualification limits.

## Exclusions and risks
State what this issue does not implement. Flag downloads, dependencies, target
inputs, native probes/runners, privileges, network or publication separately.

## Approval links
- Written specification:
- Reviewed plan (or approved bounded design for documentation-only work):
- Explicit execution authorization and scope:

An issue, assignee, label or Project state is not execution permission.
Start in **Preparation**, not Ready, until relevant approvals and prerequisites hold.

## Ownership and coordination
- One agreed primary owner:
- Issue-specific branch/bookmark and draft PR:
- Reviewer/shared-contract contacts:

Do not post credentials, private keys, session IDs or investigated input contents.
Authority: [design decisions](https://github.com/landroval/PackTrace/blob/development/docs/design-decisions.md).
